Title: Data Engineer Jr
Description: Job Description The Data Engineer Sr. is the primary builder and operator of the Rate Factory data pipeline on the D&A side. Working under the technical direction of the Tech Lead, this engineer is responsible for constructing, testing, and maintaining the ETL/ELT processes that populate the Gold Layer with the data Rate Factory needs, ensuring that sourcing pipelines are reliable, incremental, and production-grade. Qualifications Building and maintaining the Gold Layer pipeline is a full-time, ongoing workload. Every data domain that Rate Factory consumes — policy data, quotation data, vehicle data, channel data, renewal data, flotilla commercial activity — must be sourced, transformed, validated, and loaded through engineered pipelines. The Rate Factory scope covers multiple auto sub-portfolios (financiera, banca, flotillas, and eventually individual), each with its own source systems, transformation logic, and refresh cadence. This is a substantial and ongoing engineering workload that requires a dedicated, senior-level engineer. Pre-production validation before every production promotion requires engineering discipline. The Data Engineer Sr. is responsible for ensuring that the data pipeline runs correctly in the pre-production environment, that the data loaded there is representative and consistent with production expectations, and that any anomalies are caught and resolved before promotion. This is a recurring engineering responsibility. The Data Engineer Sr. must bridge D&A platform standards and Pricing's consumption needs. The Pricing team needs to consume Gold Layer data in specific ways — filtered, joined, and structured to match the inputs of the Radar pricing engine and the actuarial models. The Data Engineer Sr. must translate those consumption requirements into pipeline design, ensuring that what the Gold Layer exposes matches exactly what Rate Factory needs, in the right format, grain, and refresh cadence. This requires not just data engineering skill but domain knowledge of the auto insurance pricing process. Existing D&A team members cannot absorb this work. Current D&A México team members (including data engineers supporting Portfolio+, Claims, and BI) are fully allocated to their existing product areas. Rate Factory is a net-new workload with its own source systems, transformation complexity, and cadence. Absorbing it into existing capacity without a dedicated hire would delay both Rate Factory and the production workstreams it would displace.

Description: Human Data Quality Engineer (Founding Team) Prolific Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision. The Role As one of the founding members of Prolific's newly formed AI Data Services team, you'll help build the quality systems behind some of the world's most advanced AI models. Data quality is a strategic priority for Prolific, so this is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior stakeholders. This isn't a traditional QA role. We are not looking for someone to review data against a predefined checklist. We are looking for an innovative thinker that can leverage their expertise to define what good means where no definition exists yet. Acting as a strategic thought partner, you’ll work at the intersection of human data, machine learning, evaluation across frontier use-cases that define what high-quality human data looks like for the next generation of advanced AI. This means that much of the work involves novel problems with no established answer, so you’ll be comfortable working through ambiguity.. . Your primary focus is working directly with clients and alongside frontier AI labs, translating what their models need into robust human data and evaluation strategies. Rather than checking quality at the end of a project, you'll engineer quality into every stage of the lifecycle, from study design and participant strategy through to evaluation, launch readiness and client delivery.You will also work alongside our product engineering, and supply teams to define and build the quality infrastructure that will enable us to deliver high quality human data at scale. Much of the work you'll tackle won't have an existing playbook. You'll help create it. What You’ll Be Doing Design the quality frameworks that underpin complex human data programmes, from evaluation rubrics through to launch readiness. Work with clients as a strategic thought partner, challenging annotation schemas and data requirements when they won't produce the signal the model needs. Advise on project design and how the choice of schema can impact data quality. Build quality upstream across the operational workflow, from recruitment, screening, and training through to writing guidelines and running calibration sessions. Build scalable quality systems, measurement frameworks and automated checks using Python and SQL. Partner with product and engineering to build the quality infrastructure that delivers high-quality human data at scale. Investigate data quality and integrity issues, identifying root causes and turning insights into scalable improvements. Architect and build dashboards, monitoring and reporting that provide clear visibility into quality and operational performance. Raise the quality capability across the company, upskilling operations and acting as a thought mentor to junior analysts. Help define how Prolific approaches quality across new AI domains, shaping best practice as the team grows. What You’ll Bring to the Role 5+ years of experience in building quality, evaluation or annotation systems within AI, machine learning, LLMs or human data environments. Strong Python and SQL skills, with a passion for using data to solve complex quality problems. A solid understanding of machine learning pipelines and how human data impacts model performance. Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with experience designing scalable quality frameworks. The confidence and credibility to interact with stakeholders at frontier labs and act as a partner. The ability to leverage your experience and expertise to influence and guide stakeholders at every level, both client side and internally. in The ability to turn your own data analysis and quality methodology into requirements that product and engineering can build into systems. The ability to explain yout data analysis and findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, so they can act on them. A proactive, builder's mindset -you enjoy creating new systems, navigating ambiguity and improving how things work. Even Better if you have: Experience with LLM evaluation, RLHF, AI safety or red teaming. Experience translating vague model or evaluation goals into clear annotation specifications. Experience working with human annotation programmes or human data operations. Familiarity with calibration, inter-rater agreement, drift detection or other evaluation methodologies. Why Prolific is a great place to work We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Title: Jr Risk Analyst / Principal Afore
Description: Esta vacante está siendo ofertada por Principal Afore SA de CV ¿Qué esperamos de ti? Experiencia:De 1 a 3 años de experiencia laboral en desarrollo de software, ingeniería en la nube o automatización de procesos, así como aplicación de buenas prácticas de seguridad, monitoreo y mantenimiento de soluciones en producción. Herramientas: Python (automatización de procesos, scripts, herramientas internas e integración de sistemas), APIs REST y desarrollo de microservicios (FastAPO, Flask o Django), servicios de AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS, DynamoDB, RDS, IAM y CloudWatch y uso de Inteligencia Artificial (Copilot, Claude u otros). Title: Strategy & Operations Senior Associate
Description: Who we are Rastreator.mx is the best friend of anyone looking for insurance in Mexico. We compare more than 10 insurers in under two minutes to find the best option, and the user buys directly from the company they choose. Our mission is to help people save time and money. More than 3 million Mexicans have already found their car insurance with us. We are part of Mavriq, a global leader in price comparison, with more than 1,500 people, 20 brands and a presence in 19 locations across 3 continents. Mavriq belongs to Moltiply Group, listed on the Milan Stock Exchange. The group’s brands include Rastreator.com in Spain, LeLynx.fr in France and Segugio.it in Italy. In Mexico we are a dynamic team of only 15 people. We are in a growth phase, with several strategic projects and new products launching over the coming months and years. The role We are looking for someone to help define the future of the business while improving how it runs today. The role combines strategic projects with hands-on work in the operation. The position reports directly to the General Manager of Mexico and works closely with the Group’s international teams, which gives it high exposure from day one. The role is divided into two parts, strategy and operations. What you will do Strategy Analyze business data to support decisions on partners, profitability and where we invest Lead strategic initiatives that will help transform the business, from defining the problem to implementing them and measuring their impact Build business cases, deep dives and performance analyses for new initiatives and partnerships Turn data on customer and partner behavior into insights, and work toward a more personalized experience Present clear recommendations to the General Manager and the Group’s teams Operations Monitor the key metrics of the business, identify deviations from targets and their drivers, and propose actions Propose and implement ideas to improve the efficiency of the operation Design and build the tools and automations the team uses day to day Track the impact of implemented initiatives and keep improving them Requirements 2 to 4 years of experience, ideally in management consulting, corporate strategy, strategy & operations or growth roles Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience turning data into actionable recommendations Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. SQL, Python or BI tools are a plus A liking for technology and the habit of using it in your day to day Ownership and willingness to get hands-on in the operation Fluent in English and Spanish What we offer Competitive salary based on your experience, major medical insurance and continuous learning. You will work in direct contact with Mexico’s leadership and with the Group’s international teams. Our office is at WeWork Varsovia, Colonia Juárez, Mexico City. We work a hybrid schedule, with 1 or 2 days of home office per week. How to apply At Rastreator we would rather test and measure than assume. If that way of working appeals to you, we would be glad to meet you. Send us your CV through this posting. If your profile fits the role, we will get in touch for a first conversation. #guauguau 🐶 At Rastreator.mx we consider all applications equally, regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other condition.

Title: Customer Intelligence Analyst II
Description: Company Description At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. Job Description The Client Insights & Delivery (CID) Analyst is a foundational role within the Global Nielsen Campaign Analytics team, focused on delivering actionable recommendations that drive client success and market impact. As a member of this fast-paced, client-facing team, your primary responsibility is to work directly with media companies and advertisers to understand campaign objectives, advise on study setup, and provide performance analysis. You will assist in designing studies to measure ad effectiveness across all media platforms (digital, social, streaming, and podcasting) and perform deep-dive custom analyses under the guidance of senior members, all while maintaining a high level of quality assurance throughout every step of the process. Key Responsibilities Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with clients, Sales, Research, and Operations, acting as a partner to grow the business through Campaign Analytics (CA) solutions. Business Objectives: Help translate broad business needs into specific, measurable research questions that can be solved by Nielsen solutions. Research & Analysis: Design, execute, and present detailed research analyses, primarily focused on test vs. control methodology to determine the lift driven by measured campaigns. Client Delivery: Use Product knowledge to support clients in designing and executing studies. Analytically consult with clients on the results, ensuring insights and action-oriented solutions are delivered. Quality Assurance: Perform rigorous QA checks on test setup, data quality, and presentation materials to ensure best practices are strictly followed. Collaboration & Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate issues, find the root cause, and proactively resolve them with appropriate parties. Project Management: Maintain accurate records of study timelines, milestones, and presentation dates, keeping all relevant internal and external stakeholders updated. Qualifications 2-3 years experience in analytics and/or media or marketing planning. Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to grasp new concepts easily and present them simply. Advanced level of English (written and verbal) is required. Excellent critical thinking ability and a desire to seek solutions for novel situations. A self-motivated, curious learner with strong project and time management skills. Ability to work quickly, adapt, and manage multiple projects at once.
